title.zh: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
title.en: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】

current_state.zh: Binance launched its bStocks tokenized securities product for eligible UAE users, debuting with tokenized price-tracking exposure to Circle, Nvidia, Micron, SanDisk and Tesla stocks, issued by affiliate BTech Holdings with $5 minimums, 24/7 trading and BNB Chain self-custody support.
